name: MBPO Broadway Storefront Vacancy Survey 2020
description:
This dataset contains a 2020 survey of storefront vacancies in the Broadway corridor, with 385 sampled records and 15 columns. Each row describes a storefront location, including its address, business name (where available), the condition or indicator of the storefront, whether it is boarded up, and which side of the street it is on. Records also include geographic identifiers such as latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot (BBL), neighborhood tabulation area (NTA), borough, and postcode.

The data can be used to map and analyze storefront vacancy patterns along Broadway, compare vacancy conditions across neighborhoods, districts, or sides of the street, and support economic development, urban planning, or commercial corridor research. It may also be useful for tracking boarded-up properties and linking vacancy observations to administrative geographies for further analysis.
